# Tool — Remote MCP server, user Entra token (`type: mcp`, auth `UserEntraToken`)

Attach a remote MCP server that authenticates with the **caller's own Entra identity** — the platform forwards the signed-in user's Entra token to the MCP server (auth type `UserEntraToken`), so the server sees the **end user**, not a shared credential. No BYO app registration, client secret, or OAuth consent flow. Needs a **connection** (`--kind remote-tool --auth-type user-entra-token`) scoped to the upstream re
